title.narrative: Governance for Inclusive Development (GovID) in Ghana

description.narrative: The project Governance for Inclusive Development (GovID) in Ghana aims to contribute to the development of Governance by improving transparency, internal accountability, participation, decentralisation, and provision of public services and public finance management (PFM) so that national and sub-national Governance actors are able to finance inclusive development in Ghana. The consultancy provides advisory services delivered by a national long-term expert, who manages a pool of international, regional and national short-term experts in the form of technical consultancy services.

The services are delivered by short- and long-term experts in form of technical and administrative services related to the key intervention areas of the project. Assignments financed by FCDO include those listed below
Public Financial Management: Evidence-based analysis and preparation of sectoral budgets; Improved consideration of fiscal risks in budgetary process; Support do district plans (MTTD, DAAP) and budget preparation; strengthen the capacities for inclusive budget management at national and local levels.
3_024_Tackling serious and Organised Crime: The project aims to ascertain the current capacity of specific law enforcement agencies through an initial study and support the development and implementation of a strategy to bolster capacity where gaps have been identified. The anticipated outcome for this intervention is to improve the capacity of actors and institutions in their mandate to reduce SOC and IFFs. 3_026_Investigate cyber related crimes: This project is supporting interventions which help to strengthen the capacity of government stakeholders and Law Enforcement Agencies to fight Serious and Organized Crimes including cybercrime which impact negatively on the national budget. 3_028 Support to the creation of a national cryptocurrency task force and training on cryptocurrency 3_029 Development of a five year strategic plan (2023 - 2027) for the economic and organised crime office 3_030 Conduct a typology research study on serious and organised crime between Ghana and Nigeria 3_032 Building Capacities of law enforcement agencies to investigate and prosecute romance fraud 3_036 Capacity building training on tax fraud investigation and prosecution for investigators and prosecutors of Ghana Revenue Authority (GRA) and Tax Fraud Unit of Economic and Organised Crime Office (EOCO) 3_038 Building the capabilities of investigative journalists in the fight against illicit financial flows
